# Eastern Alignment

> Independent psychic reading reviews based on paid, first-hand testing. Every platform
> review records how many readers were tested and what was actually spent. Updated 2026.

## Platform reviews (first-hand tested)

- [Kasamba Review 2026](https://easternalignment.com/reviews/kasamba/): 35 readers tested. 3 free minutes plus 50% off the first session for new clients.
- [Keen Review 2026](https://easternalignment.com/reviews/keen/): 49 advisors tested. First 5 minutes for $1, then roughly $1.99–$20/min.
- [Purple Garden Review 2026](https://easternalignment.com/reviews/purple-garden/): $30 free credit for new clients. Per-minute rates run $1.99–$30+.
